correct_answer: 1 Red : 2 Pink : 1 White
wrong_answers_pool: 3 Pink : 1 White
3 Red : 1 White
All Pink (100%)
1 Red : 1 White
2 Red : 2 White
All Red (100%)
1 Pink : 1 White
explanation: In incomplete dominance, RW x RW produces 1 RR (Red) : 2 RW (Pink) : 1 WW (White).
